Class News

java.lang.Object
project.models.others.News
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<News>
public class News extends Object implements Comparable<News>, Serializable
A university news item. Research news sorts before general news (see compareTo(News)). Users can add comments to any news item.
